top_sast_rules.description: User input should not be used in regular expressions without first being escaped, otherwise a malicious user may be able to inject an expression that could require exponential time on certain inputs.

top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement resource consumption limits, rate limiting, and proper cleanup mechanisms for all operations.
